  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><h2 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">no worries accommodation in a <a href="/ensuite">Ensuite cabana</a> </h2><h3 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">56€ p/p</h3><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Looking for full board in Kalpitiya? This package is perfect for you if you have your own kiteboarding gear.<br>Ruuk Village is beachfront by the lagoon, 1.4 km from Kalpitiya town.  </p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Includes:</strong>  </p><ul data-rte-list="default"><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Double standard cabana per person: €56 (no tents, great beds)</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Single occupancy: €71</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Three meals daily (breakfast, lunch, dinner)</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Private shower garden and WC</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Coffee, tea, drinking water (no plastic bottles; refill stations used)</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Boat transport within Kalpitiya lagoon (sandbank drop-off/pick-up for lunch)</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Lunch served at our beach hut at no extra cost</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Use of SUPs and bicycles (depends on availability)</p></li></ul><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Half board option available on request but full board is more economical.<br>Small project with only 8 cabanas for an exclusive experience.In case you don’t wish to bring your own gear, you can also <a href="/kalpitiya-kiterentals">rent equipment</a> (Only rental with CORE Kites and CrazyFly Boards. We offer the latest material)</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">What <a href="/things-to-do-in-kalpitiya" target="">can you do in Kalpitiya</a> apart from Kiting ?&nbsp; We arrange your Wilpatthu national park visits, dolphin / blue whale watching or maybe even a night fishing - choice is yours.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">&nbsp;<br>* The price which is stated for this package includes all taxes and service charges.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">&nbsp;</p></div>
